items.q: "Misty." The girl singer that did "Misty." Do you know who it is?

ctx.x: I remember once you were in the house band with Hawk, Zoot, Clark Terry...
"Misty." The girl singer that did "Misty." Do you know who it is?
I remember Sarah Vaughn doing "Misty", but...
